summary: Star Wars game entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC version with compatibility fixes

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG-style PC version with compatibility fixes
primary.why: The PC version has the best resolution/mod/fix/capture route for KOTOR. Console/mobile/Switch versions are useful ownership alternates, but no platform-exclusive story path is sourced.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Windows PC version with compatibility/widescreen guidance as needed. Avoid overhaul mods for the base archive run unless explicitly documenting a modded route.

entries.remaster_caveats: The announced remake is not a released replacement at this checkpoint. Keep the base run unmodded unless a modded route is requested.

entries.title: Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC current build, Deluxe extras optional

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at current patch level with documented settings

primary.why: The Steam release is a current official PC route for Respawn's single-player action-adventure, with PC capture/settings flexibility and Deluxe Edition cosmetics/documentary extras available as nonessential bonus content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Windows PC build through Steam or EA app. Record storefront, patch/build, EA account/linking state, graphics settings, HDR status, difficulty, cosmetic/deluxe content, and whether New Journey+ is used.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record EA app/account requirements and patch state. Treat current-gen console upgrades as comparison routes rather than separate entries.

entries.title: Star Wars: The Old Republic
entries.definitive_edition: Current official SWTOR PC live service with expansion/subscription state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current official PC client and live servers

primary.why: The Old Republic is a live story-driven MMORPG. The current official Windows/Steam service is the content authority, while completeness depends on account, subscription/preferred status, expansion unlocks, and server state.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official PC client from swtor.com or Steam. Record server, account status, subscription/preferred/F2P state, class origin story, expansion access, build, companion/story decisions, and current patch/event state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record current developer/service state, account tier, server, and expansion unlocks.

entries.title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed
entries.definitive_edition: Ultimate Sith Edition on Windows PC for HD/content route; Switch/Wii branch separately

emulation.notes: Use native PC route; Dolphin only for Wii branch comparison.

primary.why: Ultimate Sith Edition includes the base game and DLC/bonus mission content on PC, making it the best one-route archive target for the HD branch. The Wii/Switch route uses a different control/content branch and should be compared separately if motion controls matter.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam/GOG PC Ultimate Sith Edition. Record storefront/build, controller, graphics settings, DLC missions played, and whether Wii/Switch motion-control version was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Motion-control version and Duel Mode branch
secondary.what_to_play: Compare only if documenting the motion-control branch.
secondary.why: It differs from the HD/Ultimate Sith Edition route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record whether playing HD Ultimate Sith Edition or the Wii/Switch motion-control branch.

entries.title: Star Wars Battlefront II (2017)
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC build / Celebration Edition content state

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with available online services

primary.version: Current PC / Celebration Edition content state
primary.why: The 2017 Star Wars Battlefront II is distinct from the 2005 Star Wars: Battlefront II. The PC route offers the best capture/settings path for the current multiplayer-era build, but campaign, co-op, multiplayer population, and Celebration Edition cosmetic/content state should be logged.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC version through EA app/Steam. Record build/date, Celebration Edition or standard ownership, campaign/co-op/multiplayer scope, server/matchmaking state, graphics settings, and controller or mouse/keyboard setup.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console multiplayer/service state.
secondary.why: PC is easier for capture, but live-service population can vary by platform.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not confuse this 2017 game with Star Wars: Battlefront II (2005); record online service state and edition ownership.

entries.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release, with OpenJK/mod/fix state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Patched/modded PC release with documented settings

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG PC release with compatibility fixes documented
primary.why: Jedi Academy is a PC-first Raven/LucasArts action game, and PC remains the best route for capture, controls, mods, widescreen fixes, and multiplayer/community preservation. The modern console ports are valid access routes but are not the mod/community baseline.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG PC release. Record storefront/build, compatibility/widescreen fixes, OpenJK or vanilla state, mods, controls, single-player difficulty, multiplayer/server state, and whether console ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting console behavior.
secondary.why: PC is the stronger archive route for mods, settings, and multiplayer preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record vanilla versus OpenJK, mods, widescreen fixes, and multiplayer/server state.

entries.title: Star Wars Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with TSLRCM and documented fix/mod stack

emulation.notes: Use native PC release; emulate Xbox only for launch-state comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC release with restored-content mod and documented settings

primary.version: Current PC release with The Sith Lords Restored Content Mod
primary.why: The PC route gives the best fidelity, widescreen/fix access, and the essential restored-content route. The Sith Lords Restored Content Mod restores cut material and fixes many issues, so unmodded console versions are lower-completeness archive paths.
primary.how_to_play: Use Steam or GOG PC, install TSLRCM first, then document every additional mod separately. Record storefront/build, TSLRCM version, optional M4-78 state, widescreen/fps fixes, resolution, save-route alignment, and any crashes or restored-content caveats.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only to document the unmodded launch state.
secondary.why: It lacks the restored-content route and has lower fidelity than PC.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the Switch port as a separate access path.
secondary.why: PC with TSLRCM remains the completeness route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Install restored-content mods before other mods, keep M4-78 optional and separately documented, and record mod versions/load order.

entries.title: Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release, with PS5/Xbox Series X|S comparison if PC performance blocks capture

emulation.notes: Use native PC or console builds.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with documented settings and stable capture

primary.version: Current PC release with performance/patch state documented
primary.why: PC has the highest capture ceiling for Survivor after patches, while PS5 and Xbox Series X|S are safer comparison routes for fixed console behavior. The later PS4/Xbox One ports are access routes with lower fidelity.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam/EA PC build. Record patch, store, graphics preset, RT/upscaler state, shader compilation behavior, performance metrics, controller, difficulty, New Journey+ state, and whether PS5/Series X or last-gen ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if PC performance instability affects capture.
secondary.why: PC has the highest ceiling but has had notable technical caveats.
These ports are lower-fidelity access routes, not the definitive path.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record patch, shader compilation, RT/upscaler, and performance metrics; do not treat last-gen ports as equivalent fidelity routes.

entries.title: Star Wars Jedi Knight II: Jedi Outcast
entries.definitive_edition: Current PC release with compatibility/OpenJK state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: PC release with documented vanilla/fix/mod state

primary.version: Current Steam/GOG PC release with compatibility/OpenJK state documented
primary.why: Jedi Outcast is a PC-first Raven/LucasArts action game, and PC remains the strongest route for capture, controls, widescreen/compatibility fixes, mods, and multiplayer/community preservation. Modern console ports are useful access routes but not the mod/community baseline.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam or GOG PC release. Record storefront/build, vanilla versus OpenJK or other fixes, widescreen/FOV state, mods, input, difficulty, multiplayer/server state, and whether GameCube/Xbox/Switch/PS4 ports were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only for console behavior or controller comparison.
secondary.why: PC is the stronger archive route for settings, mods, and multiplayer preservation.

entries.remaster_caveats: Modern console ports are access routes, not replacements for the PC/mod baseline.

entries.title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox 360 or PlayStation 3 HD version with Endor Bonus Mission installed; PC for base-game fidelity comparison

emulation.notes: Use owned console hardware or compatible owned digital route; PC only for base-game comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: HD console complete-content route, with PC base-game capture as secondary

primary.version: HD console version with Endor Bonus Mission installed
primary.why: The PC version is the cleaner capture route for the base game, but the Endor Bonus Mission DLC is a meaningful extra mission tied to the HD console release path. For complete route coverage, archive the Xbox 360 or PS3 version with DLC; use PC separately for high-fidelity base-game comparison.
primary.how_to_play: Use an owned Xbox 360 or PS3 copy with the Endor Bonus Mission installed, or a compatible owned-digital/backward-compatible route where available. Record platform, patch, DLC entitlement, difficulty, challenge medals, costumes, and whether PC base-game footage was captured for comparison.

secondary.what_to_play: Use for base-game fidelity/capture if the Endor mission is documented separately.
secondary.why: PC is the best-looking practical route but lacks the same complete DLC mission path.
They are not the HD complete-content target.

entries.remaster_caveats: Confirm DLC entitlement before calling the route complete; do not merge with the first Force Unleashed entry.

entries.title: Star Wars: Empire at War
entries.definitive_edition: Star Wars: Empire at War Gold Pack

emulation.notes: Use native Windows PC route with current compatibility fixes if needed.

primary.version: Star Wars: Empire at War Gold Pack / Steam or GOG
primary.why: Empire at War is a PC real-time strategy game, and the Gold Pack route includes the base game plus Forces of Corruption expansion while giving the cleanest modern Windows capture path.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam or GOG Gold Pack. Record storefront, patch/build, widescreen/mod state, multiplayer/service state, campaign/scenario, Forces of Corruption expansion progress, and any compatibility fixes.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if preserving original media behavior or patch history.
secondary.why: Gold Pack is the complete practical route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record Gold Pack, patch, mod, and expansion state; do not merge with unrelated Star Wars RTS/mod entries.
